# Site check: mychata.cz after the PR #64 publish, 18 Oct 2026 (evening)

Run about 16:05 Czech time by the site-check subagent from a cloud session. The Chrome DevTools MCP was not available, so it used Playwright with the container's Chromium (`PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), mobile viewport 390×844, cs-CZ. Read-only: no sign-in, no forms, no clicks that change anything, no data changed.

Live commit `3b8bace` (Merge pull request #64), read from `/auth` page source: `<meta name="build-sha" content="3b8baced23d4d9a65786e9991b24ed60e5f5f907"/>`, `<meta name="build-time" content="2026-10-18T13:59:29.888Z"/>` (15:59 Czech time, a minute after the #64 merge at 15:58). It is the current `origin/main`.
